# We Are Tired

> A little less noise. A little more good.

Official website: https://ayushghbk-afk.github.io/Main-website-of-company-/

## About

We Are Tired is an independent technology initiative working toward a more accessible, useful, and open internet.

The initiative aims to build practical, original, and legally compliant alternatives to digital services that create unnecessary barriers through paywalls, intrusive advertising, or poor user experiences.

## Mission

Make useful digital experiences more accessible by building better alternatives wherever possible and legal.

## Vision

An internet where people can learn, create, communicate, and get things done without unnecessary barriers.

## Areas of work

- Practical digital tools
- Open discovery and access to knowledge
- Open-source technology and alternatives
- Privacy-minded digital experiences
- Low-distraction products

These are planned areas of exploration; no products are launched yet.

## Principles

- Accessibility
- Respect for people's attention
- Privacy
- Open technology
- Legal and ethical development
- Quality and usefulness

## Launched products

None yet. We Are Tired does not currently have launched products. The Projects page describes planned areas of exploration, not available products.

## Legal and ethical approach

We Are Tired aims to create original alternatives and support responsible open technology. It does not claim ownership of third-party content or intend to bypass legitimate ownership, licensing, or access controls.
